summary:
I am currently refining an interactive career assistant that provides grounded, responsive answers based on my published site content. This project demonstrates my ability to orchestrate complex, multi-provider LLM workflows with high reliability and safety.

I am also advancing a custom imagery pipeline that uses duotone treatments to ensure a consistent editorial aesthetic across my project pages. This includes an experiment in hobby imagery to maintain an authentic yet stylized presentation.

Additionally, I am integrating an internal messaging broker and a power usage experiment to enhance my local infrastructure. These improvements support the growing complexity of my local AI stack and its automated monitoring.

highlights.oneLiner: An automated agent orchestrating multi-provider LLM workflows for dashboard and task automation.
A bounded, career-context career assistant grounded in published site content.
A custom model-swapping proxy providing a unified API for local and cloud LLM access.
